title: ControlPlaneReverifyPacket
description: SPEC §10.2, §15.6. The packet the runner hands the verifier when a task is verified again after a fix-up, or because the PR head moved since the verdict. It is not the verdict. The verifier writes a new verification/<task_id>.json whose head_sha is this packet's head_sha. An example is contracts/reverify_packet.example.json. No secrets.

reason.description: fix-up: the verifier rejected and the implementer changed the PR. head-moved: the verdict was approve, then the PR head changed.

head_sha.description: head_sha of the verdict being replaced. Null only when that verdict predated the field.

findings.description: What the previous verdict named. Empty when reason is head-moved and the previous verdict was approve.

head_sha.description: The PR head the verifier must judge now, and must write as head_sha on the new verdict.

fixups.description: What changed since the previous verdict. Required to be non-empty when reason is fix-up. Empty when the only change is that the head moved and there is no new commit message to quote.

packet.description: The same fixed packet as a first verify: no implementer transcript.
